wo-jpfa-JR4691.d:
PT Japfa Food Indonesia (Wonoayu)

Job Responsibilities**

* Perform regular in-process inspections of raw materials, semi-finished products, and production lines according to established quality control procedures and sampling plans.
* Conduct physical, chemical, and sensory tests on samples to verify compliance with quality standards and specifications.
* Monitor critical control points (CCPs) and operational parameters during production to ensure process stability and product integrity.
* Identify and document non-conforming products or processes, initiate corrective actions, and follow up on their implementation.
* Maintain accurate and detailed records of inspection results, test data, and quality control activities.
* Assist in the investigation of quality deviations, customer complaints, and production issues.
* Collaborate with production teams to implement quality improvement initiatives and ensure adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).
* Operate and maintain laboratory equipment and tools, ensuring proper calibration and functionality.
* Adhere to all safety regulations and company policies.

Job Qualifications**

* Minimum Diploma (D3) in Food Technology, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven experience (1-3 years) as a QC Inspector, preferably in a food processing or feed manufacturing industry.
* Strong understanding of quality control principles, GMP, and food safety standards.
* Proficiency in conducting various physical, chemical, and sensory tests.
* Ability to read and interpret technical specifications and quality control documents.
* Detail-oriented with excellent observation and analytical skills.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Proficient in using basic computer software (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite).

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
